d: Giant panda with a stocky, muscular build, featuring a white face, black ears, and black patches around the eyes, with a calm and focused expression. The outfit consists of a moss-green layered tunic and shoulder mantle with golden embroidery, a brown waist sash, and dark grey armor plating on the legs. Accessories include a large bundle of bamboo stalks tied with teal cords to the back and a long bamboo staff held in one hand. BODY COLOR: Black and white LEGS: Plantigrade with large, black-furred paws.
